hero.subtitle: Te peer-to-peer tibwa boki ae a roko
hero.description: Kateaki ma te decentralized teknolji ae boou. Akea te server ae mena i nuka. Akea te tabo teuana ae kona ni bua.

about.title: Ibukin
about.intro: {project} bon te platform ae a roko ibukin tibwan peer-to-peer boki, ae kateaki ma te decentralized teknolji ae boou. E katiteboboi te interface ae bebete ma te architecture ae tibwabwarara, e kakoroa raoi te tibwa boki ae mwaiti raoi ma akea te oin n authority. E open source te project aei, ao a kanakoaki i aan te {license}.

decentralized.title: Te network ae tibwabwarara raoi
decentralized.description: Akea te server ae mena i nuka, akea te tabo teuana ae kona ni bua. A kunei aoia ao a karauaki te kanoa irouia n aroia, n aki uaia n te index ae mena i nuka, te tracker ke te database.

accessControl.title: Te tabea n riringinaki ae tikiraoi
accessControl.description: Aomata nako a kona ni katea oin aia network ma aia tua n akea boona. I nanon te network ae nako, a kanawanawanaki nakoaia kaain te aba: te kuami, te administrator, te tia kanakoa, te moderator ao te tia ira. Iai am tabea n tikiraoi ibukin antai ae kona ni kanakoa, ni moderator ao ni karauaki te kanoa.

ui.title: Te interface ae raoiroi
ui.description: Te interface ae itiaki ao ae kanakoa kanoaki te media center, ae kateaki ibukin desktop, te TV ao te telephone ae moau. E bebete ni biri ma te keyboard, ratona, gamepad ke te taua remote. A kona kaain naake a kainabwabwa ni kabongana te software bwa te headless data server ma te command-line interface.

dataFormat.title: Te boki ni boki ae a kona n wareki kaain te aba
dataFormat.description: Te LISH data format e kateaki ma te JSON, ae bebete ni karaoaki, ni warekaki ao n ataki. Tibwa kanoam ma te metadata ae teretere ao ae nora, ae kona n noraki irouia kaain te aba ni kabane.

security.title: Te aki kaongoraei ao te kamano
security.description: Reitaki ni peer-to-peer ni kabane a kabongaki ao a kainakoaki, e kakoroa raoi ata bwa am data e na karaubaki rinanon te transit. A kona kaain te aba n karaba i aon te VPN ibukin riki te aki kaongoraei. {project} e karinea am aki kaongoraei i aon te oin n karaoia.

crossPlatform.title: I aon platform ni kabane
crossPlatform.description: E mena te software ibukin Windows, Linux ao macOS. Kabongana i aon platform ae ko tatangiria.

download.title: Karauaki
download.description: Anaa {project} ibukin am platform. A kabane karauaki a aki kabooaki ao bon open source.
